data.description:
# Generic story-line system in core

**Goal:** Document and track the extraction of the branching story-line mechanic from `tce-main-street` into a standalone, game-agnostic core module, plus its Gym demo.

## What landed

- `core/src/story-line/` — generic module: `types.ts` (types + `StorylineEngineAdapter`/`StorylineUiAdapter` seams), `compile.ts` (legacy `hasChoices` and CSV `options` compilation, per-system registry, draw-time condition filtering), `resolve.ts` (apply/skip, successor precedence, one seeded `rng()` draw per candidate selection, deterministic serial chain naming), `journal.ts`, `ui-adapter.ts` (pluggable seam + default implementation), `index.ts` (`createStorylineSystem` barrel). No game imports, no Phaser.
- `core/tests/story-line/` — parity unit tests (compile, resolve, journal, ui-adapter).
- `@story-line` alias wired through `resolveCoreAliases`, `core/tsconfig.json`, the game tsconfig and the scaffold template.
- `core/example-games/gym/scenes/GymStorylineScene.ts` — a branching-narrative Gym demo using the default UI adapter, registered in the Gym router/catalogue and covered by the Gym smoke test.
- `core/docs/core-engine/story-line.md` — developer reference for the module, adapters and demo.

## Acceptance criteria

- The generic module compiles and resolves at parity with Main Street's current implementation (compile + resolution parity tests green).
- The pluggable UI adapter is exercised by the Gym demo via the default implementation.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean and the core unit/smoke suites are green.
- The module and Gym demo are documented in `core/docs/core-engine/story-line.md` and the Gym index.

## Provenance

Extracted from the `tce-main-street` epic `MS-0MVCRQ475009CDZI` (children F1–F3; Main Street consumer refactor F4 tracked separately in that repo).

## Core work complete

All core-side work for the story-line extraction is landed on `dev`.

### Commits
- `5f419f7a` — `src/story-line/` generic module (types + engine/UI adapter seams, legacy/CSV compilation, per-system registry, apply/skip resolution with one seeded `rng()` draw per candidate selection and deterministic serial naming, journal helpers, pluggable default UI adapter, `createStorylineSystem` barrel); `tests/story-line/` parity tests; `@story-line` alias in `resolveCoreAliases`, `core/tsconfig.json` and the scaffold template; alias tests updated.
- `c6b1bc82` — `example-games/gym/scenes/GymStorylineScene.ts` demo (branching fixture, default UI adapter), registered in the Gym registry/catalogue, barrel, auto-generated scene list, individual-scene smoke test and Gym index.
- `fab1ce28` — `docs/core-engine/story-line.md` developer reference (API, engine/UI adapters, Gym demo, testing) plus links from `docs/DEVELOPER.md` and the Gym index.

### Verification
- `npx tsc --noEmit` clean.
- Story-line unit tests green: compile (27), resolve (20), ui-adapter (19), journal (11) — all passed in the core unit project.
- Gym smoke suite green, including `GymStorylineScene boots without errors`.
- Consumed by `tce-main-street` via the `@story-line` alias; its adapters and full suite are green (provenance commits `a328bc43`, `1d0166a6`, `2766d754`, `61214f3b`, `87486479`).

### Note
The cross-repo full-suite release gate (`MS-0MVFN55UE0096L0R` in the Main Street worklog) is blocked on host capacity: the core CI unit stage has a hard-coded 300 s wall-clock bound and the shared host was heavily loaded for many hours (0 test failures; exit 124 hang timeouts). This does not affect the module/docs deliverables above.
